name: ratecomic
description: RateComic - Monorepo con scripts para arrancar frontend y backend

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --prefix backend && npm run test:unit --prefix frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e --prefix backend && npm run e2e --prefix frontend
